title.zh: Ethereum Foundation names 2 ‘must ship’ EIPs for Hegotá upgrade
title.en: Ethereum Foundation names 2 ‘must ship’ EIPs for Hegotá upgrade

current_state.zh: Ethereum Foundation将Hegotá升级范围缩小至FOCIL和Frame Transactions（必须包含），并推迟发行量变更，将其归入更广泛的生态系统流程。
current_state.en: Ethereum Foundation narrows Hegotá upgrade scope to FOCIL and Frame Transactions (must-ship), and defers issuance changes to a broader ecosystem process.

updates.title_zh: Ethereum Foundation Sets 2029 Quantum Target and Narrows Hegotá Scope
updates.title_en: Ethereum Foundation Sets 2029 Quantum Target and Narrows Hegotá Scope
updates.what_changed_zh: 以太坊基金会将Hegotá升级范围缩小至FOCIL和Frame Transactions，并推迟发行量变更（放弃逐渐减少的发行量和强制燃烧执行奖励），将其归入更广泛的生态系统流程。
updates.what_changed_en: Ethereum Foundation narrows Hegotá upgrade scope to FOCIL and Frame Transactions, and defers issuance changes (declining tapered issuance burn and mandatory burn of execution rewards) to a broader ecosystem process.
updates.current_state_zh: Ethereum Foundation将Hegotá升级范围缩小至FOCIL和Frame Transactions（必须包含），并推迟发行量变更，将其归入更广泛的生态系统流程。
updates.current_state_en: Ethereum Foundation narrows Hegotá upgrade scope to FOCIL and Frame Transactions (must-ship), and defers issuance changes to a broader ecosystem process.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Ethereum Foundation sets a 2029 quantum target and narrows Hegotá scope, prioritizing FOCIL and Frame Transactions while deferring issuance changes.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Ethereum Foundation sets a 2029 quantum target and narrows Hegotá scope, prioritizing FOCIL and Frame Transactions while deferring issuance changes.
